notes.title: A major update to Summon skill gameplay
notes.notes:
Improved summoning skill gameplay and added summoning flow related equipment and equipment attributes 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41891384/63aedf61819f3b5b7ebcd3e0e38efc873c08333f.png

Adjusted monster attributes in high difficulty mode to increase randomness
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41891384/033e70e96bd62bdca3c9ef6658e311ecf4a30444.png

Other updates:
调整了凶猛宝石的暴击附加机制，凶猛宝石提供的暴击率直接增加技能基础暴击 
优化了技能锁敌寻路，加入怪物半径计算，解决会走到怪物位置重叠的问题 
优化了战力计算，平衡数值类属性和百分比类属性的权重，提高数值类属性的权重，削弱暴击和爆伤属性的战力权重 
优化了关卡默认难度选择，进入游戏与当前离线记录难度一致，进入关卡战斗后与当前关卡难度一致 
优化了buff类技能的技能界面显示，增加buff增益、减益、以及Dot的升级信息，以及持续时间信息 
优化了技能获得展示界面，现在仅在新解锁技能时显示 
优化了选择界面的名称和说明字体大小 
修正了召唤物实际技能和界面显示技能不一致的错误 
修正了在幻境死亡复活以后，主角不会再被怪攻击的错误 
修正了锻造界面升星时，有效增幅属性显示为灰色的错误 
修正了部分装备悬浮提示的元素穿透显示为灰色的错误 
修正了移动版符文无法卸下的错误

notes.title: Simplified Chinese version Released
notes.notes: Simplified Chinese version has been released, welcome to download! The game server will open at 10am Beijing time on June 15, 2022!

notes.title: Official version coming soon
notes.notes: The official version will be launched within a week, and the closed test is about to end. At that time, the role data of the closed test will be deleted.

notes.title: March 20, 2022 Update Notes
notes.notes:
Add a new rune system, which can be embedded on the skill bar to improve the effect of the skills in the corresponding column
Added Buff and Debuff skills, which can be obtained randomly through the skill book
Added 2 summoning skills, which can be unlocked randomly through the skill book
Added backpack making function, the Explorers Association can obtain materials every day to make backpacks to expand the backpack grid
Newly enhanced dungeon gameplay, ordinary dungeons have a chance to drop fragments, and advanced dungeon keys can be synthesized
Added window dragging function to change window size
Added shortcut key C character B backpack Tab teleport

Adjusted the rewards of advanced dungeons, and some advanced dungeons increased rune drops
Adjusted the evasion of the main line mobs and reduced the evasion rate
Adjusted the random attribute delivery range
Adjusted the drop of the main line, instead of dropping consumables directly, changed the drop of the dungeon pass
Adjusted the number of monsters to kill for the novice task, and reduced the number of requirements
Adjusted the placement of accessories, you can get it when you lower it to level 10, and increase the random attribute of movement speed
Adjusted the position of some buttons on the main interface and function list
Adjusted the weapon drop rules to match the drop according to the class, and no longer drop weapons that are not of this class
Optimize the combat power calculation formula, distinguish between physical and magical combat power calculation

Fixed a bug where some ranged skills had a chance not to resolve damage
Fixed an error showing unknown when gems were equipped
Fixed a bug where the level was too high to be swept away after the dungeon was progressively adjusted
Fixed a bug that advanced dungeons could not be entered
Fixed a bug where the summon skill baby damage was always -1
Fixed the bug that after the summon skill baby died, it could not be re-summoned
Fixed summon skill CD setting error
Fixed a bug that sometimes the main interface did not display skill icons
Fixed a bug where the character attribute interface, attribute names and values ​​were not aligned

notes.title: 2022-2-27 Update Instructions
notes.notes:
A new level package event has been added, reaching the specified level can get event reward emails
New material synthesis, right-click on the synthesisable raw material in the backpack, the synthesis interface will be opened
Added new gem types, increased to 16 gems
A new recharge system has been added. Star stones can be purchased at 1:10. Star stones can be used to purchase level material packs and can also be used to exchange diamonds at 1:10.

Adjusted the numerical curve, reconstructed the numerical system, improved the battle rhythm, and enhanced the excitement
Adjusted the casting of element attributes, increased the additional damage of each element attribute, increased damage by percentage, penetration rate, and attributes of armor and resistance
Adjusted the damage calculation method. Physical magic damage and element attribute damage can be superimposed for calculation.
Adjusted the crit calculation method, adding bonuses based on the skill's basic crit rate, and calculating whether a crit hit
Adjusted the slot limit of gems, only distinguishing between ruby ​​and sapphire
Adjusted the attribute delivery of gems, and added elemental gems and element attribute delivery
Adjusted the attribute delivery of added points
Adjusted the equipment refinement level limit
Adjusted quest rewards
Adjusted the objectives of some missions
Adjusted and optimized the special effects of a number of skills

Fixed a bug where the Activity Chest could not receive the Wind Emblem
Fixed a bug that the selection interface could not be closed with the Esc shortcut
Fixed a bug where you couldn't point and move during battle
Fixed a bug where the dungeon had a chance to get stuck at the spawn point
Fixed a bug where the remaining quantity was not refreshed after purchasing an item in the store
Fixed the bug that there was no confirmation prompt when leaving the dungeon and illusion
Fixed a bug that the resurrection prompt of death in the illusion was incorrect
Fixed a bug where the special effects played incorrectly after the projectile hit the target

Shielded hardening system, refactored
The guild system is shielded and refactored
Shielded the suit system and refactored
Blocked gem store, refactored
